gen-tourney-gf-mozilla-text: Flat fineliner strokes, all one width, stretched out by generous tracking. Mozilla Text then takes over beneath Tourney, its tall-bodied lowercase looking bold and its terminals flaring outward, a livelier foil to all that flat line.
gen-tourney-gf-nobile: Tourney stretches its bulky small letters out with wide tracking, every stroke cut to one width. Nobile keeps small letters near cap height, mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, a lighter counterpoint.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Tourney cuts every stroke to one width, and its curves never thin at the turns, stretched wide by tracking. Noto Sans Avestan, with its pronounced x-height, can go a little smaller.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a swollen midsection and a c like pliers. Tourney above it holds one unvarying weight from word to word, a steady foil for that crowded midsection.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Athletic through and through, Tourney moves stems and arcs in lockstep, with a flat monoline stroke and wide tracking. Tourney belongs big and brief, with Noto Sans Brahmi handling the rest.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tourney cuts monoline strokes with bulky small letters and wide tracking, while Noto Sans Deseret keeps open apertures. Punchy headlines handing off to wide-looking lowercase with squat ascenders, friendly throughout.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Tourney stretches its bulky small letters with wide tracking, every stroke as plain as a fixed-width stencil brush. Noto Sans Elymaic sits low and open, ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Flat-cut and stretched wide, Tourney is all bulk. Noto Sans Ethiopic, tall and sturdy with c terminals hanging far from the bowl, can stay modest in size beside it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-p: Blunt and sporty, Tourney draws its up strokes and side strokes with no visible difference. Tourney does its best work big and brief, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian gives its e and a big open eyes.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Chunky and athletic, Tourney keeps its curves full right through the shoulders, with wide tracking. But Noto Sans Limbu is the one for reading, tall-bodied and gaping, where Tourney simply shouts.
